{{Top}}
A '''tactical officer''' was a type of [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served on a [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. [[Breha Organa's cousin|The cousin]] of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] served as a tactical officer on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] ship ''[[Bespin Dancer]]'' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the ''Dancer'' was [[Fall of Falleen|destroyed]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces and Organa's cousin was [[Death/Legends|killed]].
